title: Artificial Artificial Intelligence: Measuring Influence of AI 'Assessments' on Moral Decision-Making
reasoning: The paper's central focus is to empirically study the effect of AI-generated feedback on human moral decision-making, using kidney allocation as a moral dilemma. Keywords listed include 'AI ethics', 'computer ethics', and 'moral psychology', indicating that evaluating moral and ethical behavior is a core component of the research, not a peripheral consideration.
